textNotes.text: After killing him once I decided to farm the chest loot. The dungeon is long and time-consuming, so I found a fast method using 3 deaths to spawn much closer to Kuldra each run. During the fight I also discovered a bug that lets you carry the orb into the next phase, which speeds the fight up a lot and makes it much easier.
I did the whole farm on Easy mode to make it even faster. It took me around 12 hours to get the full set of Level 9 armour and weapons.
